$comment: The Worker's redirects (src/worker.ts): a source path, the path it sends to (301). The link check (scripts/links.mjs) reads this table too: a link to a source passes when its target opens a page. /docs is the address apps and old links print: it goes to the help pages (60.12). A help topic whose id changes keeps its old path here, sent to the new one (/help/<old>/ and /ar/help/<old>/).
